an6.62:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena Daṇḍakappakaṃ nāma Kosalānaṃ nigamo tad avasari.
an6.62:1.3: Atha kho Bhagavā maggā okkamma aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle paññatte āsane nisīdi,
an6.62:1.4: te ca bhikkhū Daṇḍakappakaṃ pavisiṃsu āvasathaṃ pariyesituṃ.
an6.62:2.1: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ yena Aciravatī nadī ten' upasaṅkami gattāni parisiñcituṃ.
an6.62:2.2: Aciravatiyā nadiyā gattāni parisiñcitvā paccuttaritvā ekacīvaro aṭṭhāsi gattāni pubbāpayamāno. 2.
an6.62:2.3: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yenāyasmā Ānando ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ etad avoca
an6.62:2.4: ‘kin nu kho āvuso Ānanda sabbaṃ cetaso samannāharitvā nu kho Devadatto Bhagavatā vyākato
an6.62:2.5: "āpāyiko Devadatto nerayiko kappaṭṭho atekiccho" ti, udāhu kenaci devapariyāyenā' ti?
an6.62:2.6: ‘Evaṃ kho pan'etaṃ āvuso Bhagavatā vyākatan' ti. 3.
an6.62:3.1: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an6.62:3.2: ‘idhāhaṃ bhante sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ yena Aciravatī nadī ten' upasaṅkamiṃ gattāni parisiñcituṃ.
an6.62:3.3: Aciravatiyā nadiyā gattāni parisiñcitvā paccuttaritvā ekacīvaro aṭṭhāsi gattāni pubbāpayamāno.
an6.62:3.4: Atha kho bhante aññataro bhikkhu yenāhaṃ ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā maṃ etad avoca:
an6.62:3.5: Kin nu kho āvuso Ānanda sabbaṃ cetaso samannāharitvā nu kho Devadatto Bhagavatā vyākato
an6.62:3.6: "āpāyiko Devadatto nerayiko kappaṭṭho atekiccho" ti, udāhu kenaci devapariyāyenā ti?
an6.62:3.7: Evaṃ vutte ahaṃ bhante taṃ bhikkhuṃ etad avoca:
an6.62:3.8: Evaṃ kho pan'etaṃ āvuso Bhagavatā vyākatan' ti.
an6.62:4.1: ‘So vā kho Ānanda bhikkhu navo bhavissati acirapabbajito, thero vā pana bālo avyatto. Kathaṃ
an6.62:4.2: hi nāma yaṃ mayā ekaṃsena vyākataṃ tattha dvejjhaṃ āpajjissati?
an6.62:4.3: Nāhaṃ Ānanda aññaṃ ekapuggalam pi samanupassāmi, yo evaṃ mayā sabbaṃ cetaso samannāharitvā vyākato, yathayidaṃ Devadatto.
an6.62:4.4: Yāvakīvañ cāhaṃ Ānanda Devadattassa vālaggakoṭinittuddanamattam pi sukkaṃ dhammaṃ addasaṃ,
an6.62:4.7: Yato ca kho ahaṃ Ānanda Devadattassa vālaggakoṭinittuddanamattam pi sukkaṃ dhammaṃ na addasaṃ,
an6.62:5.1: Seyyathā pi Ānanda gūthakūpo sādhikaporiso pūro gūthassa samatittiko,
an6.62:5.3: Tassa koci-d-eva puriso uppajjeyya atthakāmo hitakāmo yogakkhemakāmo tamhā gūthakūpā uddharitukāmo,
an6.62:5.4: so taṃ gūthakūpaṃ samantānuparigacchanto na passeyya tassa purisassa vālaggakoṭinittuddanamattam pi gūthena amakkhitaṃ, yattha taṃ gahetvā uddhareyya:
an6.62:5.5: evam eva kho ahaṃ Ānanda yato Devadattassa vālaggakoṭinittuddanamattam pi sukkaṃ dhammaṃ na addasaṃ,
an6.62:5.8: Sace tumhe Ānanda suṇeyyātha Tathāgatassa purisindriyañāṇāni vibhajantassā' ti?
an6.62:6.2: yaṃ Bhagavā purisindriyañāṇāni vibhajeyya, Bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantī' ti.
an6.62:6.3: ‘Tenah' Ānanda suṇāhi sādhukaṃ manasikarohi, bhāsissāmī' ti.
an6.62:6.4: ‘Evaṃ bhante' ti kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavato paccassosi.
an6.62:7.1: Idhāhaṃ Ānanda ekaccaṃ puggalaṃ evaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajānāmi
